  Excellent entry-level exposure for a graduate with an industry giant  
  Contract / Temp (3 Months - Full-Time or Part-Time options available)  
 Great, rewarding opportunity for mature-age job seekers/ retirees 
 
  About the Company  
  Our client is an international market leader and innovator in connected technologies and advanced electronics. Operating on the cutting edge of sustainable tech, they develop intelligent systems that transform commercial, industrial, and residential spaces globally. They are currently seeking a technically sharp Engineer to join their specialized testing facility in Moorebank on an initial 3-month contract, with flexible full-time or part-time hours to suit the right candidate.  
  Role Purpose  
  In this hands-on lab role, you will test, diagnose, and analyze advanced electronic equipment and connected hardware to ensure compliance with strict quality and safety standards. This is an exceptional opportunity to gain exposure to state-of-the-art testing machinery, digital drivers, and smart automated networks.  
  Key Responsibilities  
 
  Test and diagnose advanced electrical components and smart system hardware using oscilloscopes, power analyzers, and specialized lab equipment.  
  Evaluate products against local safety regulations and radio disturbance standards (such as AS/NZS or equivalent international frameworks).  
  Troubleshoot automated network interfaces and digital driver software (utilizing protocols like DALI, Zigbee, or Bluetooth Low Energy).  
  Assist in managing, calibrating, and maintaining laboratory equipment to ensure complete data integrity.  
  Document test results and compile clear technical findings for engineering teams.  
 
  Skills & Experience Required  
 
  A Bachelor's Degree in  Electrical Engineering or Electrical Trade Certification  is mandatory  
 Experience in electrical testing (preferably within a NATA-accredited environment) 
 Knowledge of measurement uncertainties, electrical theory and testing techniques.

 Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and generate actionable insights. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear and comprehensive technical reports. 
 Competency in using MS Office applications especially Excel. 
 Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and time management skills. 
 Ability to work both independently and as part of a close-knit team in a fast-paced environment.

Your new company  
 You will be joining one of Australia's largest underground mining operations and play a critical role in supporting and improving the operational technology systems that keep the site running safely, reliably and efficiently. 
   
  Your new role  
 We are seeking an experienced Process Control Engineer with strong expertise in Rockwell PLCs, AVEVA Plant SCADA (Citect) and Cicode development to support a range of operational and improvement initiatives across processing and mining operations. 
  Key responsibilities include:  
 
  Supporting and maintaining Rockwell ControlLogix and CompactLogix PLC systems.  
  Developing, supporting and enhancing AVEVA Plant SCADA (Citect) applications.  
  Developing and troubleshooting custom Cicode applications.  
  Investigating and resolving complex PLC, SCADA, instrumentation and communication issues.  
  Supporting commissioning, shutdowns and operational readiness activities.  
  Driving process optimisation, reliability improvements and continuous improvement initiatives.  
  Supporting control system upgrades, modifications and capital projects.  
  Managing change control, documentation and engineering governance requirements.  
 
   
  What you'll need to succeed  
 
  Degree qualification in Electrical, Automation, Control Systems or Mechatronics Engineering.  
  5+ years' experience in Process Control, Automation or Control Systems Engineering.  
  Advanced experience with Rockwell ControlLogix and CompactLogix platforms.  
  Advanced experience with AVEVA Plant SCADA (Citect).  
  Demonstrated experience developing and supporting Cicode applications.  
  Strong PLC programming, commissioning and fault-finding skills.  
  Experience within mining, minerals processing, heavy industrial or manufacturing environments.  
  Strong understanding of industrial communications protocols including Ethernet/IP, Modbus and OPC.  
 
   
  What you'll get in return  
 
  8-12 month contract opportunity.  
  4 days on, 3 days off FIFO roster - 12hr days.

Duties and Responsibilities:
As a IT Consultant/Programmer, you will be responsible for analysing, assessing, designing, developing, testing, implementing maintaining and supporting quality applications that supports the company’s key objectives.

Main responsibilities include:
• Writing software code, automated unit tests, and debugging the code to delivery documented working software that meets the requirements in accordance to FedEx secure code practices, policies and established coding standards.
• Translate business requirements and system requirements into detailed technical specifications or business features and user stories using the SAFe Agile framework.
Provide technical mentoring and guidance to other developers.
• Design application solutions that meet complex business requirements, modelling the solution and implement code reviews and other quality management practices across a team of developers.
• Implement software development design patterns to deliver on complex technical requirements to deliver well-engineered working software that is scalable, resilient, maintainable, performant, secure, fault-tolerant, portable, extensible, reusable, testable and easy to use.
• Design and execute complex application testing for functional and non-functional testing including stress and load testing, building test doubles/hubs, test management data, regression testing and complex scenario and use case management.

Analyst and Support Tasks:
• Consultation and analysis of key systems with Stakeholder.
• Collaborating with the enterprise Applications Team and Operations Team around production incidents involving integration to directly or indirectly ensure their timely resolution/recovery and preventative measures are taken to avoid recurrence and minimize business impact
• Maintenance of operational and end-user documentation
• Planning and technical delivery of integration work packages

Experience and Qualifications:
• Minimum 2+ years experience using Java JMS API in a Linux/Unix environment.
• Experience in developing Java applications in Cloud Native environment.
• Experience in building microservices using Spring Core and Spring Cloud.
• Extensive knowledge and experience in using Microservices Architecture Patterns.
• Experience in TDD and BDD practices using Java & Spring based Junit & BDD frameworks.
• Good knowledge and experience in using Kafka for message streaming and for event driven pub/sub notifications.
• Experience in modern networking, IPV4 stack, ICMP, UDP, TCP/IP, socket programming.
• Experience with working with databases e.g. MSSQL, MYSQL, Informix, Oracle.
• Proven ability to lead the development of software development projects.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or similar
SAFe Agile certification highly desirable
